summary: Flat aluminum round-end (stadium-shaped) pattern plate, 56mm long, 32mm wide and 2.5mm thick. It has two large 14mm through holes along the centerline and a surrounding goBILDA hole pattern, some of it slotted.

mountingSurfaces.description: Top flat face of the plate, used for mounting hardware and parts against the hole pattern
Bottom flat face of the plate, used to clamp against rails, channel or other parts

notes: Length (56), width (32) and thickness (2.5) are the listed dimensions, and the ends are full semicircles of radius 16. The 14mm hole diameter is listed. The ±12mm spacing of the two large holes is estimated from the images, which also show them centered on the width axis and concentric with the rounded ends. The smaller pattern holes (about 14 visible, some slotted) follow the listed 16mm goBILDA pattern. Their 4mm diameter is assumed from that standard and not stated here, and their positions are left empty because the images give no printed coordinates.
